notes: 1926 six-storey flats, white painted stucco upper storeys over a green glazed-tile base. Ground: a round-arched entry with a stone surround at the left, a narrow dark door, a barred window. Tree hides most of the uppers; plain windows from the data, no ornament invented. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Dark green tile ground band up to the belt course, cream upper wall. Bays: the tree hides the upper storeys, so the claim of bays is unsupported and none are added. Round-arched entry left and grilled window kept. Lifted/converted once to #f6f0e0. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #2f6f50 -> #598c73 (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
